name: building-blocks-actions
title: Actions
description: Tiny Tailwind-first action atoms that can be composed into buttons, controls, and toolbars.
useWhen: Tiny Tailwind-first action atoms that can be composed into buttons, controls, and toolbars.
avoidWhen: Avoid actions when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Actions uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
